'''Herrik''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the remote [[Herrik system/Legends|Herrik system]] that orbited a [[Herrik's sun|star]]. The [[Star/Legends|star]] emitted a unique form of stellar interference that caused numerous equipment failures and [[Droid/Legends|droid]] malfunctions among a research team in the system.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Multiple Malfunctions}}</ref>
